registry_policy.purpose: Capability and dependency catalog for repository automation programs.
registry_policy.registration_required_for: Every non-package Python component under scripts/ and storage/v2/, plus every active GitHub Actions workflow under .github/workflows/.
registry_policy.collaboration_rule: A program may run independently under its own entry point. Cross-program orchestration requires an explicit registry entry and declared workflow dependencies or dispatch targets.
registry_policy.permission_rule: Registry declarations describe boundaries; they never grant permissions. The workflow job's least-privilege permissions remain authoritative.
registry_policy.activation_rule: Registration is mandatory for CI acceptance, but does not by itself authorize automatic dispatch, rule activation, publication, or modification of modules/uu.conf.
registry_policy.exclusion_rule: Exactly four GitHub Actions workflow entry points are registered. During queue migration, historical target IDs may be represented by non-workflow compatibility components; deleted workflow paths and deleted workflow-dispatch adapters must never be restored.
